Gold's AUSA SDNY background (1973-1977, corruption and securities fraud units) gave him the connections to accomplish this.

Harry Wachtel.description: Harry Wachtel co-founding partner of Gold and Wachtel which served as process agent for J. Epstein and Company Inc from 1988. Harry was alive and active at the firm when Epstein became a client.
William B Wachtel is the son of Harry H Wachtel. Both were partners at Gold and Wachtel. William became founding partner of successor firm Wachtel Missry LLP after Harry died Feb 1997.
